experiment_type: bundled product-shape diagnostic followed by component ablations
objective: Test whether a coding-native, append-only evidence union can retain upstream Mike's model familiarity while using legal structure to expose less repeated source text and automatic deterministic checks to correct real draft errors.

held_constant.transport: OpenAI Responses API using the project API key, not the Codex subscription backend
held_constant.split: visible Harvey LAB development tasks only

provider_policy.receipt_requirement: Record requested and provider-reported tiers. Do not label a run Fast unless the provider reports priority.
provider_policy.fallback: A rejected or unreported priority request does not block the experiment. Relaunch on the ordinary tier under a distinct run id and exclude its latency from priority-tier comparisons.
provider_policy.comparison_constraint: Latency and cache comparisons require the same actor model, effort, transport, and reported service tier. Existing non-priority results remain quality and behavior references, not formal latency controls.

candidate_bundle: The first targeted Grep working_set call creates one stable turn-local evidence file and includes a bounded file map compiled from provisions, headings, defined terms, and native table headers.
Later targeted searches append only source spans not already represented in the file and return a Read recipe for the new delta.
Matched-source budget is cumulative and monotonic; map text has a separate 12000-character ceiling.
The working set is append-only and exists only for the current turn; original documents remain the edit targets.

Automatic post-synthesis checks can trigger one repair pass only for draft-touching arithmetic, temporal, defined-term, or lint errors. Source-only anchors and source-source conflicts remain telemetry, not repair instructions.
insert_blocks creates tracked paragraphs with independently rejectable paragraph marks, avoiding whole-document retyping for common drafting operations.
H5 and the historical H8 arm retain their original hashed stateless working-set behavior and receive no file map.
primary_observations: native LAB score, per-criterion failures, deliverable validity, and whether a requested file was produced
whether the first source-content retrieval is a targeted working_set Grep and the returned delta is read
map, matched-source, already-present, omitted, and appended characters per working-set call
gross and unique source exposure, replay ratio, direct versus virtual document reads, and missed source documents
tool-call failures, redundant calls, provider rounds, tool argument/result bytes, input/output/cache tokens, and latency
which deterministic findings caused repair, whether the repair changed the artifact, and whether the change fixed or damaged a rubric item
whether block insertion or exact legal scopes avoid retyping and whether any model-visible schema field is unused or misunderstood
diagnostic_failure_conditions: The H9 runtime exposes H5's hashed stateless artifact or H5 receives H9's map/accretion behavior.
The working-set path changes within a turn, a repeated identical search appends source text, or simultaneous calls reorder additions.
A returned Read recipe cannot read the promised delta or loses source-qualified evidence segments.
Rejecting one inserted tracked paragraph leaves its text or an empty paragraph residue.
The compiler asks the model to repair source-only anchor absence or a conflict confined to source documents.
The upstream comparator receives any Beaver-only tool, prompt, progressive disclosure, or legal-structure affordance.
A priority run is reported as such without a provider receipt of priority.
interpretation_policy: H9 deliberately bundles mutually supporting infrastructure and is not a clean component-level causal estimate. Trace inspection precedes attribution. A score gain does not validate every component; a loss does not invalidate legal structure. Retrieval misses, attention/synthesis misses, mutation failures, compiler regressions, and harness failures must be classified separately.
planned_ablations_after_diagnostic: H9 without the compact file map
H9 without the automatic repair checkpoint
H9 with the same accretive union but an economy instruction grounded only in an observed redundancy or misunderstanding
H9 with the same accretive union but an accuracy instruction grounded only in an observed omission mechanism
non_goals: Cross-turn persistence of the evidence file
A semantic citator product or relevance model
Treating the four diagnostic cells as a final benchmark claim
Prompt micro-optimization before tool-level behavior is understood
